title: Rwandan genocide
summary: Hutu Power militias and many civilians murder Tutsi and moderate Hutu on a mass scale in about a hundred days.
body: The UN and major powers failed to stop it. The later Congo wars grew in part from the same explosion. Editorial draft for this timeline, not a substitute for specialist literature.
